title: DevKit Quickstart: Snapshot sequence, README mockups, and multi-theme screenshots
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Goal: produce a compact, developer-centric snapshot sequence and README visual set for the DevKit reference app that can be dropped into the public docs and template repo. Scope includes: 1) a 6-frame snapshot sequence that demonstrates sign-up -> API key creation -> local dev run -> first inference -> console traces -> cost dashboard; 2) README hero diagram (annotated, 3 variants: light/dark/high-contrast) sized for GitHub and docs; 3) three full-width product screenshots for release notes (light/dark/responsive) and 2 animated GIFs (30s loops, 720p) for use in social/marketing. Key decisions: prefer captioned screenshots over long paragraphs in README; produce both static PNGs and SVG callouts for maintainability; prioritize contrast and alt-copy for accessibility. Trade-offs: animated GIFs increase repo size; to mitigate we will host GIFs in Drive and use compressed web versions in docs. Reviewers requested smaller code font and a brighter CTA color for readability in dark mode. Deliverables must include Figma source, exported assets, and a short usage guide for engineers to update screenshots in CI. Links to design spec and CI script are below.
